name: restore-display-mode
description: Restore the display mode recorded by set-display-mode-tabs through the product settings control.

metadata.name: restore-display-mode
metadata.description: Restore the display mode recorded by set-display-mode-tabs through the product settings control.

evaluate.expression: (() => { const mode = sessionStorage.getItem('__bas_previous_display_mode') || 'sidebar'; const button = document.querySelector(`[data-testid='display-mode-${mode}']`); if (!(button instanceof HTMLElement)) throw new Error(`cannot restore display mode: ${mode}`); button.click(); const root = document.querySelector('[data-display-mode]'); document.body.setAttribute('data-bas-display-mode-restored', root?.getAttribute('data-display-mode') === mode ? 'true' : 'false'); })()

assert.failure_message: Expected the previous product display mode to be restored
